Apple Pay is the go-to feature for iPhone users when shopping in physical stores, online, or within apps. Apple recently announced four new features that make Apple Pay even better — here's how they work.

iOS 27 新設計

iOS 27 其中一項我最喜愛的改動，是重新設計的 Apple Pay 付款介面。新介面讓用戶在網站及應用程式內的付款流程中，更輕鬆地切換不同的信用卡。

In the new design, users can swipe between credit cards directly from the main Apple Pay screen, or tap to see all available Apple Pay cards in a grid view.

The new design also makes it easier to view information for individual cards, including rewards, balances, installment options, and more.

iOS 27 目前已向開發者及公眾測試版用戶提供測試版本，預計將於今年秋季正式推出。

美美國運通獎賞

Apple 與美國運通近日宣佈建立新合作夥伴關係，讓用戶可以運用美國運通的獎賞積分付款。

When using an American Express card to shop online or in an app, users will see a new "Use Rewards" option in the Apple Pay checkout flow, showing their available Membership Rewards points balance. Users can apply points at checkout to cover all or part of their purchase.

American Express points redeemed through Apple Pay are worth 0.7 cents each. For example, 10,000 points would equal $70 toward a purchase.

一拍即分享

在 iOS 27 中，Apple 將新增「一拍即分享」功能，將實體店購物體驗與 iPhone 上的 Apple Pay 結合。

This feature is an extension of Tap to Pay on iPhone, which Apple says will launch this fall. Here's how Apple describes it:

With a simple tap, customers can connect with a participating merchant's iPhone for a more personalized and faster in-store shopping experience, securely sharing information such as email and other contact details, shipping address, and membership rewards info. Customers can also view their cart in real time to keep track of what they've purchased and ensure all promotions and discounts have been properly applied.

Once finished, customers can check out directly on their iPhone with Apple Pay.

為扣賬卡增值

今年稍後，iPhone 用戶將可以在 Apple Pay 介面內直接管理扣賬卡結餘。

據 Apple 表示，用戶將可透過 Apple Pay，在 Apple Wallet 內或結帳時，直接為支援的扣賬卡增值。

總結

隨着 Apple Pay 在零售商之間日益普及，能夠見到 Apple 持續優化使用體驗實在令人欣喜。就個人而言，無論是網上或實體店購物，Apple Pay 都是我首選的付款方式。

你有多常使用 Apple Pay？最喜愛哪些 Apple Pay 功能？歡迎在留言區告訴我們。

我最愛的 iPhone 配件：

  • 內置屏幕的 Anker Nano USB-C 牆插充電器
  • AirPods Pro 3：查看最新優惠價
  • 同時為所有 Apple 裝置充電
  • 將無線 CarPlay 帶到任何汽車
  • 顯示充電速度的 USB-C 線

追蹤 Chance：Threads、Bluesky、Instagram 及 Mastodon。
